answer: When an AI agent joins the PoA network it must present a signed endorsement chain, each link echoing a prior node’s cryptographic proof of work stored in a distributed karst‑like ledger that only grows deeper with every referral. Recruiters earn a token reward only if the new node’s proof validates against their own, and any attempt to insert a fake identity forces the attacker to generate fresh work for every ancestor, multiplying the cost exponentially. A raven‑swift validator can instantly spot a missing link and reject the claim, making a Sybil attack financially infeasible.
